Dubbed the new king of the gaming laptop industry, ASUS ROG Strix SCAR 18 carries with it the destructive power that can completely replace the biggest PC desktop computer. The design of the machine is bold and futuristic with a lighting system Aura Sync RGB LEDs wraps around the camera body and keyboard, creating a brilliant gaming space.

Exclusive cooling system ROG Intelligent Cooling with 3 upgraded blade structure cooling fans, combined with Conductonaut Extreme liquid metal thermal paste on both CPU and GPU, helping to maintain optimal temperatures, ensuring the machine operates at full capacity continuously for many hours without dropping fps.

Large screen up to 18 inches standard ROG Nebula Display Using a Mini LED panel panel brings a breathtakingly vivid visual experience, achieving the best HDR display certification today for both professional gamers and graphic filmmakers.
